findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_download" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: billing_portal_link · Private data: search_catalog, claim_free_app, get_download · Public sink: get_checkout · Destructive: claim_free_app, get_download.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: billing_portal_link · Private data: search_catalog, claim_free_app, get_download · Public sink: get_checkout · Destructive: claim_free_app, get_download

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
